title: What happens when you pay by card online
desc: A yes or no comes back in about two seconds, but the money moves days later. Follow the numbers in A, then compare the two steps in B.

sections.title: Authorisation: a yes or no in two seconds

cards.name: You
cards.text: Enter the card details at checkout and press Pay.

cards.name: The shop
cards.text: Sends your order. Card details go straight to the gateway.

cards.name: Payment gateway
cards.text: Wraps the request in a safe, standard format.

cards.name: Card network
cards.text: Visa or Mastercard: the postman between the banks.

cards.name: The shop's bank
cards.text: Also called the acquirer. It receives the shop's money.

cards.name: Your bank
cards.text: Checks your money and the fraud signals, then decides.

cards.name: Approved
cards.text: The money is put on hold.

cards.name: Declined
cards.text: Nothing is held. The shop is told no.

sections.closing: The answer travels back the same way, bank to network to bank to shop to you.

rows.label: What moves
rows.left: Nothing. A hold is placed on the money.
rows.right: The money itself, minus small fees.

rows.label: Who is involved
rows.left: All six: you, shop, gateway, two banks, network.
rows.right: Mostly the banks and the network.

rows.label: Can it be undone?
rows.right: Only as a refund, which takes days.

rows.name: Not enough money
rows.text: There is nothing to approve. Try another card.

rows.name: Looks like fraud
rows.text: An unusual place or amount. Call the bank to allow it.

rows.name: The bank wants proof
rows.text: A screen asks you to confirm in your banking app (3-D Secure).

sections.label: Like a hotel stay

left.name: Check-in
left.text: The hotel holds your card as a deposit. That is authorisation.

right.name: Check-out
right.text: The hotel really charges the card. That is settlement.

sections.closing: Same idea, different clock: the promise is instant, the money is not.
